pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and stellate dark regions exhibiting serrated, high-frequency edge gradients. Pixel saturation is higher in patch centers relative to the perimeter.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous network of light-toned pathways with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency bristled silhouette visible along the cervical-dorsal transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian subject (potential oxpecker) on the posterior-dorsal region near the tail base.
